statements.statement: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for the patient
The patient has a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
The service is medically necessary to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
The submitted clinical indication note supports the need for this procedure to evaluate the patient's cardiac symptoms and arrhythmias
The denial reason code is PR-204
The diagnosis codes submitted are I49.9, I48.91, and R55
